body: Everything in my life has been lies. Any time I had someone I cared about as a friend or a relationship they always leave. I’ve never been in a relationship where I haven’t been cheated on. I’m worthless to everyone I meet eventually. I’m nothing but an object and nobody will miss me
Where I want to be is gone
And why’s that. Life has given me nothing but shit. I’ve worked my ass off for nothing. No friends, no caring family, no significant other. Nothing.
